name: std::filesystem::path::has_root_path, std::filesystem::path::has_root_name, std::filesystem::path::has_root_directory, std::filesystem::path::has_relative_path, std::filesystem::path::has_parent_path, std::filesystem::path::has_filename, std::filesystem::path::has_stem, std::filesystem::path::has_extension
intro:
Checks whether the path contains the corresponding path element.

1) Checks whether root_path() is empty.

2) Checks whether root_name() is empty.

3) Checks whether root_directory() is empty.

4) Checks whether relative_path() is empty.

5) Checks whether parent_path() is empty.

6) Checks whether filename() is empty.

7) Checks whether stem() is empty.

8) Checks whether extension() is empty.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the corresponding path component is not empty, false otherwise.

summary: Checks whether the path contains the corresponding path element.
